subject: Backfill request: senior ML infra vacancy - approval to repool vs external hire
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Backfill request: senior ML infra vacancy - approval to repool vs external hire

Team —

Quick context: Rahul (SRE/ML Infra) resigned last week; his official last day is 2026-10-29. This is a critical role (low-latency model serving + KV cache infra). I opened a req (attached) for Senior ML Infra Engineer (jobcode MLINF-SR) and am looking for a quick decision on approach:

Options proposed:
- Internal repool/transfer (move an existing SWE/infra headcount to this slot or convert a contractor) — fastest, keeps knowledge in house, may require comp-band uplift for the transferee.
- External search via agencies / direct hire — cleaner match sometimes but will take longer and higher sourcing cost.

Ask: please confirm whether we should proceed with an internal transfer (I believe Vivek can repool) or approve the external req and the temporary band uplift. If internal, confirm which headcount to repool and whether finance will OK a one-time comp uplift.

Quick numbers (estimates):
- Target comp band for this senior ML infra: $160k-$210k total comp (band 5/6 depending on level).
- External search timeline: 8–12 weeks.
- Internal transfer timeline: ~2–4 weeks to move and onboard.

Attachments: req_2026-MLINF-SR.pdf (JD + hiring justification).

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Revenue Operations (covering GTM resourcing)
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Backfill request: senior ML infra vacancy - approval to repool vs external hire

Jordan —

Thanks for the heads-up. Short note from ML Infra POV: we strongly prefer an internal repool if feasible. Key reasons:
- Rahul's stack is bespoke (custom KV cache + model-sharding hooks). Ramp for an external candidate will be long and risky for Q4 SLAs.
- We have one strong candidate in-house: Ava Chen (currently on infra reliability rotation) who has the low-latency serving experience and has worked with our kernel-level optimizations. Ava would need a comp band uplift to move from SDE2 -> Senior ML Infra (band uplift request below).

If we can convert a contractor slot (Sourcing contract: Acorn Recruiting), we can move faster. Vivek — can you confirm whether you can free a headcount or convert the contractor? Also looping Laura for budget confirmation on a one-time band uplift for an internal transfer.

Neha Kapoor
Head of ML Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Katelin @ Talent Partners <katelin@talentpartners.com>, Acorn Recruiting <sourcing@acornrec.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Backfill request: senior ML infra vacancy - approval to repool vs external hire

Quick sourcing note — I've run both models: internal transfer vs external search. Summary attached (comp_band_comparison.xlsx). Highlights:
- Internal transfer (Ava Chen): 2–4 week timeline; typical uplift request is a one-time adjustment of base + sign-on to match new band. Net annual delta ~ +10–12% on current comp depending on level.
- External hire via agencies: 8–12+ weeks; average org cost (agency fees + salary ramp) ~ 1.3x the internal uplift in first year.
- Contractor conversion: converting the existing contractor (contract code CTR-1089 managed by Acorn) would free a slot but requires Headcount owner sign-off and a conversion packet.

Recruiting recommendations:
1) Approve internal repool of Ava as primary plan and open a parallel external search as contingency (quick sourcing retained with Katelin/Acorn).
2) Approve a one-time comp-band uplift and up to $20k sign-on for internal transfer to reduce friction.
3) If repool not possible by 2026-10-14, trigger full external search.

Attachments: comp_band_comparison.xlsx (spreadsheet with band comparisons and cost estimates).

Marissa Cole
Senior Technical Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Backfill request: senior ML infra vacancy - approval to repool vs external hire

Jordan / team —

I can repool one headcount from the platform reliability team: we have a contractor (CTR-1089) whose engagement winds down end of month. I am willing to convert the contractor into a perm role for ML Infra and shift the current platform hiring plan by one slot. My asks before I greenlight:
- Formal approval from Finance for the one-time comp uplift (Laura)
- Sign-off on an up to $20k sign-on to make the internal move non-detrimental to the internal candidate's existing compensation trajectory.
- Confirmation that we will place a contingency external search live on 2026-10-14 if the repool stalls.

If finance confirms, we can announce internally and get Ava moved by the week of 10/19.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:20:00 -07:00

Thanks for the clear options. Finance decision: APPROVED with conditions.

Conditions / notes:
- One-time comp-band uplift and up to $20k sign-on for an internal transfer is approved from Q4 hiring discretionary budget (code: HR-Q4-26). Please ensure the final offer letter documents the uplift as a one-time adjustment, not a permanent re-banding without HR review.
- Headcount transfer must be recorded with HR: complete headcount_transfer_form.pdf and route to People Ops (link: https://docs.google.com/forms/headcount-transfer).
- If we convert the contractor, please update contractor ledger and include the expected delta in the Oct financial close. I'll need the final comp numbers by 2026-10-18 to include in the month-end forecast.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance - People & GTM
Redwood Inference
